organizer.name: Ameeshi Goenka
organizer.description: Ameeshi Goenka is the founder of Around Big Cities (ABC), a community-driven platform that curates treks, road trips, heritage walks, outdoor adventures, and experiential events across India.An entrepreneur and interior designer by profession, she also leads DPG Interiors, where she specializes in creating thoughtful and functional spaces. Her passion for travel, nature, culture, and human connection inspired the creation of ABC—a platform that brings together like-minded people through meaningful outdoor experiences.Through ABC, Ameeshi aims to make adventure accessible, safe, inclusive, and memorable for participants of all ages and experience levels.
